description: Defines the HttpChunkedDecoder class for decoding HTTP chunked transfer encoding, including license and RFC references.

classes.name: HttpChunkedDecoder
classes.description: Implements decoding of HTTP chunked transfer encoding, managing chunk parsing, EOF detection, and buffer filtering.

methods.name: reached_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the chunked data has been reached.

methods.name: bytes_after_eof
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes after the final CRLF.

methods.name: FilterBuf
methods.description: Filters out chunk markers from the buffer and detects end of data.
